Author: The Combat Reborn Team (fork by IndividualGather)
Name: RotationSolverRebornButBetter
Description:
An unofficial fork of Rotation Solver Reborn by The Combat Reborn Team: https://github.com/FFXIV-CombatReborn/RotationSolverReborn
All credit for the plugin goes to the original authors.

Why this fork exists: the official plugin only runs the rotations built into it. This fork adds a single feature: it also loads rotation DLLs from the CustomRotations folder in the plugin's config directory, so custom rotations can be maintained separately instead of in a full fork of the plugin.

Everything else is unchanged. It is rebuilt automatically from every official release, with a teal theme to tell it apart.

Not affiliated with or supported by The Combat Reborn Team. Please don't report issues with this fork to them.
Punchline: Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action. Loads extra rotations from the CustomRotations config folder.
